text:
Brian Stewart shares family movie night experience featuring “HEAT” on social media
Ohio State Representative Brian Stewart, a Republican legislator for Ohio House District 12 and an Iraq War veteran, shared his enthusiasm for the film "HEAT" in a series of tweets posted on August 12, 2026. Stewart recounted introducing the movie to his teenage children and reflected on his long-standing appreciation for the film.
In his first post at 20:03 UTC, Stewart wrote: "The #StewFest summer movie adventure ended with a (literal) bang: the grand finale - Stewart teenagers’ first viewing of my all-time favorite movie, HEAT. 4K disc. Super loud. And it floored them. One of the best home viewings ever."
Later that evening at 20:50 UTC, he continued by referencing his ongoing engagement with the film through podcasting: "Of course, my love for HEAT is well-documented. This is one of our all-time most downloaded episodes of #OfficeGrunts."
At 20:53 UTC, Stewart described a new discovery during this latest viewing experience: "I’ve watched HEAT dozens upon dozens of times. But it was not until this most recent viewing - in 4K - that I discovered something cool that’s been hiding in plain sight:
The name plate on Neil’s security guard jacket at the end reads 'C. Stewart.'
Brian Stewart has served as an infantry veteran in the Iraq War and earned both the Combat Infantryman’s Badge and two Army Commendation Medals (official website). He represented Madison and Pickaway counties as well as part of western Franklin County and co-chaired the inaugural meeting of the Ohio Redistricting Commission (official website). In addition to movies such as "HEAT," Stewart's interests include sports, target shooting, American history books, and Johnny Cash's music.
